environment.description: Node.js 18 Apollo Server v4 deployed on EC2 behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) with no request inspection. MongoDB 6.0 on same VPC with no authentication enabled. GraphQL endpoint exposed directly at /graphql with no middleware validation. Environment variables: NODE_ENV=production, MONGO_URI=mongodb://10.0.1.50:27017

config.network: VPC with public subnet, security group allows 0.0.0.0/0:4000
